svg.title: TechTideAI agent hierarchy
svg.desc: The Local Group Director routes work to ten galaxy orchestrators: Andromeda (Product + GTM); Milky Way (Finance + Analytics); Triangulum (Sales); Centaurus A (Engineering); M87 (Compliance); Whirlpool (Marketing); Sombrero (Customer Success); Pinwheel (HR + People Ops); Cartwheel (Content + Docs); Circinus (CS Triage). Each orchestrator leads five star-cluster workers, fifty in total.
svg.text: THE ORG CHART IS THE ARCHITECTURE

g.text: id: ceo · routes tasks to leads
